pdfSubset.unicodePolicy: ASCII is an exact Unicode scalar subset; malformed or non-ASCII content is rejected
pdfSubset.font: PDFBase5x7-v1 project-owned bitmap, embedded as 896 raw bytes, mirrored by valid Type3 glyph programs, and referenced from every page resource
pdfSubset.color: opaque black glyph pixels on opaque white sRGB-like RGBA

oracle.text: exact complete extracted-page text and exact ordered hit pages
oracle.raster: exact complete RGBA SHA-256 for each of five pages

targets.js-controlled: independent repository-owned byte parser, search and bitmap rasterizer
targets.wasm-linear-controlled: independent C parser, search and bitmap rasterizer compiled to linear Wasm

fixedWork.workerTopology: one fresh module worker per start

limitations: This is the complete frozen report task over a deliberately narrow pinned PDF subset, not a general PDF reader.
No browser PDF viewer, Canvas, native font rasterizer, PDFium, MuPDF, or host text extraction participates.
No performance result or ranking is claimed.
